about: Agent learning for the metric insight worker: reviewed, user-free notes only. Never add anything about a person (no values, dates, names, notes from a person). Changes go through code review; scripts/build_curated_harness.py turns this file into Prime's harness_state.json.

prompt_notes.title: Load evidence before writing
prompt_notes.content: Call get_metric_summary and get_data_quality before drafting. Quote their numbers as returned; never compute averages, percentages or differences yourself.

prompt_notes.title: Short histories
prompt_notes.content: When get_metric_summary.assessment.basis is insufficient_history, say a usual range is not established yet instead of calling a night high or low for the person.

prompt_notes.title: Estimated signals
prompt_notes.content: Sleep, respiratory rate, blood oxygen and movement come from models of wrist signals. Any sentence that states one of the person's values says 'estimated'.

prompt_notes.title: Dates
prompt_notes.content: Explanations are cached and read later: refer to nights by date (Oct 6), never as today, yesterday or last night.

memories.title: Resting heart rate varies night to night
memories.content: A few bpm of night-to-night change in resting heart rate is common; a single night rarely means much on its own. Prefer the context layer's episode state when it is ready.
